source_records.content_text:
KERNEL PRIME FERTILITY HOSPITAL A, BENGALURU
COMPREHENSIVE INITIAL FERTILITY WORKUP & BASELINE PROFILE
PATIENT: Priya S. | ID: P-101 | AGE: 33 yrs | DATE: 2026-01-10
PRIMARY CLINICIAN: Dr. Ananya Rao, MD, DNB (OBGYN)
INDICATION: Primary subfertility for 2 years, Diminished Ovarian Reserve.
FEMALE ENDOCRINE INVESTIGATIONS (Day 2):
Serum AMH was 2.1 ng/mL.
Serum FSH: 6.2 mIU/mL.
Serum LH: 4.5 mIU/mL.
Serum TSH: 1.9 mIU/L.
Serum Estradiol (E2): 42.0 pg/mL.
TRANSVAGINAL PELVIC ULTRASOUND:
Antral Follicle Count: Right ovary 6, Left ovary 5 (Total AFC 11 follicles).
MALE PARTNER EVALUATION:
Partner Semen Analysis: Volume 3.0 mL, Concentration 45 million/mL, Motility 62%, Normal morphology 5% (Normozoospermia).
PLAN: Initiate GnRH Antagonist protocol for IVF with ICSI backup.

source_records.author: Dr. Ananya Rao
source_records.content_text:
KERNEL PRIME FERTILITY HOSPITAL A, BENGALURU
CONTROLLED OVARIAN STIMULATION & FOLLICULAR MONITORING FLOWSHEET
PATIENT: Priya S. | ID: P-101 | CYCLE: IVF Cycle 1 | PROTOCOL: GnRH Antagonist
STIMULATION SUMMARY (2026-01-12 to 2026-01-22):
Medications: Recombinant FSH (Inj Gonal-F 225 IU OD D2-D11), Inj Cetrotide 0.25 mg OD D7-D11.
Day 10 Monitoring (2026-01-22): Endometrial thickness 10.2 mm (trilaminar).
Serum Estradiol (E2): 2450.0 pg/mL. Serum Progesterone (P4): 0.85 ng/mL.
Follicles >= 17 mm: Right ovary 18 mm, 18 mm, 17 mm; Left ovary 19 mm, 18 mm, 17 mm.
TRIGGER ORDER: Dual trigger Inj Decapeptyl 0.2 mg + Inj Ovitrelle 250 mcg given 2026-01-22 at 22:30.
Ovum pickup scheduled exactly 36 hours post-trigger on 2026-01-24 at 10:30.

source_records.author: Dr. S. Nair, Chief Embryologist
source_records.content_text:
KERNEL PRIME FERTILITY HOSPITAL A, BENGALURU
OVUM PICKUP (OPU) & EMBRYOLOGY LAB ASSESSMENT REPORT
PATIENT: Priya S. | ID: P-101 | DATE: 2026-01-24
OPERATIVE FINDINGS: Transvaginal ultrasound guided oocyte aspiration under IV propofol anesthesia.
TOTAL OOCYTES RETRIEVED: 10 oocytes.
EMBRYOLOGY ASSESSMENT:
Mature Oocytes (MII): 8 oocytes. Intermediate (MI): 1, Germinal Vesicle (GV): 1.
Fertilization method: ICSI performed 4 hours post-retrieval.
Fertilization check (Day 1): 6 fertilized with 2PN (Normal 2PN fertilization).
Day 5 Blastocyst Development:
Embryo 1: Grade 4AA (Expanded blastocyst, excellent ICM and TE).
Embryo 2: Grade 4AB (Expanded blastocyst).
Embryo 3: Grade 3BB (Early blastocyst).
PLAN: Fresh Single Blastocyst Transfer scheduled for Day 5 (2026-01-29); remaining 2 blastocysts vitrified in Liquid Nitrogen.

source_records.author: Dr. Ananya Rao
source_records.content_text:
KERNEL PRIME FERTILITY HOSPITAL A, BENGALURU
EMBRYO TRANSFER PROCEDURE & PREGNANCY OUTCOME REPORT
PATIENT: Priya S. | ID: P-101 | DATE: 2026-01-29 & 2026-02-12
PROCEDURE: Fresh Single Blastocyst Transfer performed on 2026-01-29.
Embryo transferred: Single Grade 4AA blastocyst loaded in Wallace catheter.
Catheter check: Clear, no retained embryo or blood on tip.
Luteal phase support: Tab Dydrogesterone 10 mg TID + Vaginal Progesterone gel 8% daily.
PREGNANCY TEST RESULT:
Serum beta-hCG test on 2026-02-12 (14 days post-ET): 385.0 mIU/mL (Positive).
Clinical impression: Viable clinical pregnancy confirmed. Advise first obstetric viability scan in 2 weeks.

PATIENT: Anitha R. | ID: P-102 | DOB: 1995-08-14 | DATE: 2026-06-14
CLINICIAN: Dr. Ananya Rao, MD, DNB (OBGYN)
CLINICAL SUMMARY: 29-year-old presenting with primary infertility for 3 years, oligomenorrhea, and Rotterdam PCOS.
INVESTIGATIONS PERFORMED ON 2026-06-14:
Serum AMH was 2.4 ng/mL.
Serum FSH: 5.4 mIU/mL.
Serum LH: 12.8 mIU/mL (Elevated LH:FSH ratio > 2.3).
Serum TSH: 2.1 mIU/L.
Serum Estradiol (E2): 55.0 pg/mL.
PELVIC ULTRASOUND (2026-06-14):
Bilateral polycystic ovarian appearance with peripheral string-of-pearls follicles. Antral Follicle Count: 26 follicles.
IMPRESSION: High ovarian reserve PCOS phenotype. Planned for antagonist protocol.

source_records.author: Dr. Ananya Rao
source_records.content_text:
KERNEL PRIME FERTILITY HOSPITAL A, BENGALURU
CLINICAL PRE-STIMULATION CONSULTATION & STRATEGY NOTE
PATIENT: Anitha R. | ID: P-102 | DATE: 2026-06-20
AUTHOR: Dr. Ananya Rao, MD, DNB
Reviewed multi-hospital reports: Hospital A AMH 2.4 ng/mL (2026-06-14) vs Hospital B AMH 1.2 ng/mL (2026-06-16).
Because AFC is 26 and LH is elevated (12.8 mIU/mL), clinical phenotype reflects high ovarian reserve.
Recommend proceeding with moderate dose antagonist protocol (150-175 IU) and agonist trigger to prevent ovarian hyperstimulation.
Plan: Recheck baseline labs prior to cycle initiation.
